transfer.animation.the-animation-data-is.note: Import error for an animation entry that has no animation data in it. It tells the user that entry was skipped.

transfer.count.n-4.note: Count of library images in an import or export summary. {n} is the number of items.

vars.n: The count the text is about.

transfer.count.n-5.note: Count of drawn SVG icons in an import or export summary. {n} is the number of items.

vars.n: The count the text is about.

transfer.envelope.animation-files-are-im.text: Animation files are imported in the card editor (My animations) or the animation studio.
transfer.envelope.animation-files-are-im.note: Hint in the import report when an animation file is opened in the wrong place. It tells the user where animation files are imported.

transfer.envelope.animations-do-not-stor.text: Animations do not store a description, so it was not kept.
transfer.envelope.animations-do-not-stor.note: Import report line for an animation file that carries a description. It tells the user the description was dropped.

transfer.envelope.animations-do-not-stor.text: Animations do not store an author, so it was not kept.
transfer.envelope.animations-do-not-stor.note: Import report line for an animation file that carries an author. It tells the user the author was dropped.

transfer.envelope.icon-files-are-importe.text: Icon files are imported in the card editor (My icons) or the SVG editor.
transfer.envelope.icon-files-are-importe.note: Hint in the import report when an icon file is opened in the wrong place. It tells the user where icon files are imported.

transfer.envelope.image-files-are-import.text: Image files are imported in Magic Card Utils > Images.
transfer.envelope.image-files-are-import.note: Hint in the import report when an image file is opened in the wrong place. It tells the user where image files are imported.

transfer.envelope.key-is-not-a-preset-fi.text: "{key}" is not a preset field, so it was left out.
transfer.envelope.key-is-not-a-preset-fi.note: Import warning. {key} is the name of a setting found in the file, written in English. Keep it as is. Same English as the image loader message.

vars.key: The value that replaces key in the text.

transfer.envelope.nothing-in-this-file-c.text: Nothing in this file could be imported.
transfer.envelope.nothing-in-this-file-c.note: Summary line of the import report when every entry failed. It tells the user nothing was added.

transfer.envelope.only-icons-and-images-.text: Only icons and images have keywords, so they were left out.
transfer.envelope.only-icons-and-images-.note: Import report line for keywords found on a kind that does not use them. It tells the user the keywords were dropped.

transfer.envelope.shape-files-are-import.text: Shape files are imported in the card editor (My shapes) or the shape editor.
transfer.envelope.shape-files-are-import.note: Hint in the import report when a shape file is opened in the wrong place. It tells the user where shape files are imported.

transfer.envelope.some-keywords-were-not.text: Some keywords were not valid (at most 10 words of 1-32 characters), so they were left out.
transfer.envelope.some-keywords-were-not.note: Import report line when keywords break the limits. It tells the user the allowed count and length and that the keywords were dropped.

transfer.envelope.step-n-plays-name-whic.text: Step {n} plays "{name}", which is not in this file. It works if you already have it.
transfer.envelope.step-n-plays-name-whic.note: Import warning for an animation sequence. {n} is the step's position, starting at 1. {name} is the name of another animation that the step starts.

vars.n: The value that replaces n in the text.
vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

transfer.envelope.the-author-must-be-1-m.text: {max, plural, one {The author must be 1 character, so it was left out.} other {The author must be 1-# characters, so it was left out.}}
transfer.envelope.the-author-must-be-1-m.note: Import warning. {max} is the longest author name allowed, in characters. The author is the creator named in the file.

vars.max: The most characters the author can have.

transfer.envelope.the-checker-for-images.text: The checker for images did not load, so this image was not read.
transfer.envelope.the-checker-for-images.note: Error raised while reading a file before import (envelope check). Same English as the panel error, but a different code path. 'Checker' is the validator.

transfer.envelope.the-description-must-b.text: {max, plural, one {The description must be 1 character, so it was left out.} other {The description must be 1-# characters, so it was left out.}}
transfer.envelope.the-description-must-b.note: Import warning. {max} is the longest description allowed, in characters.

vars.max: The most characters the description can have.

transfer.envelope.the-id-id-appears-twic.text: The id "{id}" appears twice in this file; the first one was used.
transfer.envelope.the-id-id-appears-twic.note: Import warning. {id} is a technical identifier found in the file. Keep it as is.

vars.id: The value that replaces id in the text.

transfer.envelope.the-id-must-be-1-64-lo.text: The id must be 1-64 lowercase letters, digits, - or _.
transfer.envelope.the-id-must-be-1-64-lo.note: Validation error for an item identifier in an imported file. Keep the hyphen and underscore characters as written.

transfer.envelope.the-name-must-be-1-80-.note: Validation error for a name inside an imported file. Library rename uses 'The name must be 1 to 80 characters.' with different wording.

transfer.envelope.the-name-says-want-but.text: The name says {want}, but the file holds {found}.
transfer.envelope.the-name-says-want-but.note: Import error. The file name suggests one kind of item, such as animations, but the content is another kind. {want} and {found} are item kinds with a count, such as 3 animations.

vars.found: The value that replaces found in the text.
vars.want: The value that replaces want in the text.

transfer.envelope.theme-files-are-import.text: Theme files are imported in Magic Card Utils > Themes.
transfer.envelope.theme-files-are-import.note: Hint in the import report when a theme file is opened in the wrong place. It tells the user where theme files are imported.

transfer.envelope.this-entry-is-not-an-o.text: This entry is not an object.
transfer.envelope.this-entry-is-not-an-o.note: Import error for one list entry that is plain text or a number instead of a record. It tells the user that entry was skipped.

transfer.envelope.this-file-holds-kind-p.text: This file holds "{kind}" presets, which this version of Magic Card does not know.
transfer.envelope.this-file-holds-kind-p.note: Import error. {kind} is the preset type written in the file, in English, such as animation. Keep it as is.

vars.kind: The value that replaces kind in the text.

transfer.envelope.this-file-holds-more-t.text: {max, plural, one {This file holds more than # item, so it was not read.} other {This file holds more than # items, so it was not read.}}
transfer.envelope.this-file-holds-more-t.note: Import error. {max} is the largest number of items one file may hold.

vars.max: The most items a file can hold.

transfer.envelope.this-file-is-larger-th.text: This file is larger than 8 MB, so it was not read.
transfer.envelope.this-file-is-larger-th.note: Size error for a chosen image file (envelope check). Same English as the text-reading error, which comes from the parser. 8 MB is a fixed limit.

transfer.envelope.this-file-needs-a-newe.text: This file needs a newer Magic Card (format {major}.x).
transfer.envelope.this-file-needs-a-newe.note: Import error. {major} is the major version number of the file format, such as 2. The x stays as a literal letter.

vars.major: The value that replaces major in the text.

transfer.envelope.this-is-not-a-magic-ca.text: This is not a Magic Card preset file.
transfer.envelope.this-is-not-a-magic-ca.note: Import error when the pasted or chosen file lacks the preset file markers. It tells the user the file is of another kind.

transfer.envelope.this-text-is-larger-th.text: This text is larger than 1 MB, so it was not read.
transfer.envelope.this-text-is-larger-th.note: Import error when the pasted text is over the size limit. It tells the user nothing was read and why.

transfer.icon.a-link-name.note: Names what was removed from an imported SVG, used inside Removed {what}. {name} is the link's attribute, such as href. Lower case, a noun phrase.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

transfer.icon.a-script.note: Names what was removed from an imported SVG, used inside Removed {what}. A script is program code embedded in the file. Lower case, a noun phrase.

transfer.icon.a-style-attribute.note: Names what was removed from an imported SVG, used inside Removed {what}. A style attribute is inline CSS on an element. Lower case, a noun phrase.

transfer.icon.a-use-reference.note: Names what was removed from an imported SVG, used inside Removed {what}. Keep <use>, an SVG element name. Lower case, a noun phrase.

transfer.icon.count.note: Import notice for an SVG. {what} is one of the lower case phrases such as a script or a link (name). {count} is how often it was removed.

vars.count: The count the text is about.
vars.what: The value that replaces what in the text.

transfer.icon.key-is-not-valid-path-data.text: "{key}" is not valid path data, so it was left out.
transfer.icon.key-is-not-valid-path-data.note: Import warning. {key} is the name of a field found in the file, in English. Keep it as is. Path data is the text that describes a drawn line.

vars.key: The value that replaces key in the text.

transfer.icon.no-svg-element-found.note: Icon import error. Keep <svg> exactly as written; it is the SVG tag name, not a word to translate.

transfer.icon.open-it-in-the-svg-editor-.text: Open it in the SVG editor and save to show it in Home Assistant's own cards.
transfer.icon.open-it-in-the-svg-editor-.note: Hint for an imported animated icon: 'it' is the icon. Saving it in the SVG editor makes it appear in Home Assistant's standard cards.

transfer.icon.the-attribute-name.note: Names what was removed from an imported SVG, used inside Removed {what}. {name} is an SVG attribute name such as onclick. Lower case.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

transfer.icon.the-event-handler-name.note: Names what was removed from an imported SVG, used inside Removed {what}. {name} is an attribute such as onclick that runs code on an event. Lower case.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

transfer.icon.the-icon-has-no-svg.note: Import error for an icon entry without a drawing. It tells the user that icon was skipped.

transfer.icon.the-icon-is-larger-than-kb.text: The icon is larger than {kb} KB.
transfer.icon.the-icon-is-larger-than-kb.note: Import error. {kb} is the largest file size allowed, in kilobytes.

vars.kb: The value that replaces kb in the text.

transfer.icon.the-icon-is-too-large.note: Import error for an icon entry over the size limit. It tells the user that icon was skipped.

transfer.icon.the-svg-could-not-be-read.text: The SVG could not be read.
transfer.icon.the-svg-could-not-be-read.note: Import error when an icon's drawing is not valid SVG. It tells the user that icon was skipped.

transfer.icon.the-svg-has-no-shapes-to-d.text: The SVG has no shapes to draw.
transfer.icon.the-svg-has-no-shapes-to-d.note: Import error when an icon's SVG holds nothing drawable. It tells the user that icon was skipped.

transfer.icon.the-svg-is-larger-than-32-.text: The SVG is larger than 32 KB.
transfer.icon.the-svg-is-larger-than-32-.note: Import error when an icon's SVG is over the 32 KB limit. It tells the user the size cap and that the icon was skipped.

transfer.icon.the-svg-is-too-complex.note: Import error when an icon's SVG has too many shapes or points. It tells the user to simplify it; the icon was skipped.

transfer.icon.the-view-box-is-not-four-n.text: The view box is not four numbers, so it was taken from the SVG.
transfer.icon.the-view-box-is-not-four-n.note: Icon import note. The view box is the SVG viewBox attribute (x, y, width, height); the value was replaced by the one in the SVG itself.

transfer.image-transfer-loader.key-is-no.text: "{key}" is not a preset field, so it was left out.
transfer.image-transfer-loader.key-is-no.note: Import warning for an image file. {key} is the name of a setting found in the file, written in English. Keep it as is. Same English as the envelope message.

vars.key: The value that replaces key in the text.

transfer.library-view.added-n-to-this-ca.note: Confirmation after an import into the card's own library. {n} is how many items were added, as a number.

vars.n: The value that replaces n in the text.

transfer.library-view.animations.note: Tab name in the library window. Lists saved animations (plural noun).

transfer.library-view.cancel.note: Button in the library window that abandons a rename or delete. Same English as the panel button, but a different screen.

transfer.library-view.close.note: Button that closes the library window. Same English as the panel button, but a different screen.

transfer.library-view.could-not-reach-ma.text: Could not reach Magic Card Utils. Nothing was changed.
transfer.library-view.could-not-reach-ma.note: Error when a write such as rename, delete or import failed because the add-on did not answer. Keep the product name Magic Card Utils unchanged.

transfer.library-view.could-not-reach-ma.text: Could not reach Magic Card Utils. Your work is safe.
transfer.library-view.could-not-reach-ma.note: Error when the add-on did not answer while the library was loading or saving. Reassures that nothing was lost. Keep the product name unchanged.

transfer.library-view.delete.note: Button that confirms deleting the chosen library item. Verb.

transfer.library-view.delete-name.note: Accessible label for a row's delete button, read by screen readers. {name} is the item's name, as the user typed it.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

transfer.library-view.delete-name-cards-.text: Delete {name}? Cards that use it keep their own copy, or show the default.
transfer.library-view.delete-name-cards-.note: Confirmation question before deleting a library item (animation, shape, icon or image). {name} is the item's name. Starts as a question, then a reassurance.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

transfer.library-view.delete-name-themes.note: Confirmation question before deleting a theme preset. {name} is the preset's name. The second sentence says dashboards already using the theme are not changed.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

transfer.library-view.deleted-name.note: Confirmation shown after a delete. {name} is the name of the item that was removed.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

transfer.library-view.edit-name.note: Accessible label for a row's edit button, read by screen readers. {name} is the item's name.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

transfer.library-view.export.note: Button that opens the export panel for the library. Verb, not a noun.

transfer.library-view.export-all.note: Button that exports every item in the current tab. Shown when nothing is selected.

transfer.library-view.export-n-selected.note: Button shown when items are ticked. {n} is how many items are selected, as a number.

vars.n: The value that replaces n in the text.

transfer.library-view.icons.note: Tab name in the library window. Lists saved animated icons (plural noun).

transfer.library-view.images.note: Tab name in the library window. Lists saved SVG images (plural noun).

transfer.library-view.images-need-magic-.text: Images need Magic Card Utils. It is installed through HACS, like Magic Card.
transfer.library-view.images-need-magic-.note: Hint in the library window's Images tab when the add-on is missing. Same English as the panel hint. Keep HACS, Magic Card and Magic Card Utils unchanged.

transfer.library-view.import.note: Button that opens the import panel for the library. Verb, not a noun.

transfer.library-view.imported-items-are.text: Imported items are saved in this card.
transfer.library-view.imported-items-are.note: Hint under the import button when Magic Card Utils is not installed: items stay inside the card's own configuration.

transfer.library-view.imported-ok-of-tot.note: Result of an import. {ok} is how many items were imported, {total} is how many were in the file. Both are numbers.

vars.ok: The value that replaces ok in the text.
vars.total: The value that replaces total in the text.

transfer.library-view.it-changed-while-y.text: It changed while you were looking. The list is reloaded; try again.
transfer.library-view.it-changed-while-y.note: Conflict error: another editor changed the item before the user's action was saved. The list refreshes itself.

transfer.library-view.keep-your-own-item.note: Banner shown when the add-on is not installed. 'Items' are the user's saved animations, shapes and icons. Keep Magic Card Utils unchanged.

transfer.library-view.kind.note: Label for the tab group: the type of item shown (animations, shapes, icons, images, theme presets). Noun, not 'kind' as in friendly.

vars.kind: The value that replaces kind in the text.

transfer.library-view.kind-3.text: {kind, select, animation {No animations match "{q}".} shape {No shapes match "{q}".} icon {No icons match "{q}".} image {No images match "{q}".} other {No theme presets match "{q}".}}
transfer.library-view.kind-3.note: Empty search result. {kind} is a code: animation, shape, icon, image or other (other means theme presets); do not translate the codes. {q} is the search text the user typed.

vars.kind: The value that replaces kind in the text.
vars.q: The value that replaces q in the text.

transfer.library-view.kind-4.note: Empty state of a tab with nothing saved. {kind} is a code: animation, shape, icon, image or other (other means theme presets); do not translate the codes.

vars.kind: The value that replaces kind in the text.

transfer.library-view.loading.note: Status text while the library list is being fetched from the add-on.

transfer.library-view.magic-card-utils.note: Product name of the companion add-on, used as the label of the storage source. Do not translate.

transfer.library-view.maximise.note: Button that enlarges the library window to fill the screen. Pairs with 'Restore size'. Verb.

transfer.library-view.move-window.note: Accessible label for the drag handle on the library window's title bar.

transfer.library-view.n-could-not-be-sav.note: Import result line. {n} is how many items failed to save, as a number. Not a plural form, so write it to suit any count.

vars.n: The value that replaces n in the text.

transfer.library-view.n-did-not-fit-the-.text: {n} did not fit: the library is full.
transfer.library-view.n-did-not-fit-the-.note: Import result line. {n} is how many items were skipped because the storage limit was reached, as a number.

vars.n: The value that replaces n in the text.

transfer.library-view.new-icon.note: Button that opens the icon editor with an empty animated icon.

transfer.library-view.new-name-for-name.note: Label of the rename text field. {name} is the item's current name.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

transfer.library-view.new-shape.note: Button that opens the shape editor with an empty shape.

transfer.library-view.rename-name.note: Accessible label for a row's rename button, read by screen readers. {name} is the item's name.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

transfer.library-view.renamed-to-name.note: Confirmation after a rename. {name} is the new name.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

transfer.library-view.resize-window.note: Accessible label for the drag handle in the library window's corner.

transfer.library-view.restore-size.note: Button that returns the maximised library window to its normal size. Pairs with 'Maximise'.

transfer.library-view.save.note: Button that confirms a rename in the library window. Verb.

transfer.library-view.select-name.note: Accessible label for a row's tick box, read by screen readers. {name} is the item's name.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

transfer.library-view.shapes.note: Tab name in the library window. Lists saved card shapes (plural noun).

transfer.library-view.source.note: Label for the choice of where items are stored: this card or Magic Card Utils. Noun, not source code.

transfer.library-view.the-library-is-ful.note: Error when saving would exceed the storage limit. Single-item version of the import line '{n} did not fit'.

transfer.library-view.the-name-must-be-1.text: The name must be 1 to 80 characters.
transfer.library-view.the-name-must-be-1.note: Validation error under the rename field. The limits 1 and 80 are fixed numbers.

transfer.library-view.theme-presets.note: Tab name in the library window. Lists saved dashboard theme presets (plural noun).

transfer.library-view.this-card.note: Storage source option: items saved inside the current card only. Pairs with 'Magic Card Utils'.

transfer.library-view.try-again.note: Button after a failed load of the library list. Repeats the request.

transfer.library-view.update-magic-card-.text: Update Magic Card Utils to keep theme presets.
transfer.library-view.update-magic-card-.note: Hint in the library window's Theme presets tab when the installed add-on is too old. Same English as the panel hint. Keep the product name unchanged.

transfer.library-view.your-account-can-u.text: Your account can use the library but not change it. Ask an admin.
transfer.library-view.your-account-can-u.note: Permission error for a Home Assistant user without admin rights. 'Admin' means a Home Assistant administrator.

transfer.panel.cancel.note: Button in the import/export panel that abandons the step. Same English as the library window button, but a different screen.

transfer.panel.choose-a-file.note: Button that opens the system file picker for an import.

transfer.panel.close.note: Text button that closes the import/export panel. Same English as the library window button, but a different screen.

transfer.panel.copied.note: Confirmation after the export text was copied to the clipboard.

transfer.panel.copy.note: Button that copies the export text to the clipboard. Verb.

transfer.panel.copy-as-ha-theme.note: Button that copies a theme preset as YAML to paste into Home Assistant's themes file. HA means Home Assistant.

transfer.panel.could-not-copy-the-text-i.text: Could not copy. The text is selected: press Ctrl+C.

transfer.panel.download.note: Button that saves the export as a file on the user's device. Verb.

transfer.panel.downloaded-name.note: Confirmation after a download. {name} is the file name, for example an exported file's name with its extension.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

transfer.panel.every-browser-that-shows-.text: Every browser that shows a dashboard with this theme asks {hosts} for files, and those sites can see the visitor's IP address.
transfer.panel.every-browser-that-shows-.note: Privacy warning when a theme loads files from other websites. {hosts} is a list of website domain names, such as example.com, already joined with commas; do not translate it.

vars.hosts: The value that replaces hosts in the text.

transfer.panel.export-animations.note: Heading and button of the export step; counts the animations that are exported.

vars.n: The count the text is about.

transfer.panel.export-icons.note: Heading and button of the export step; counts the icons that are exported.

vars.n: The count the text is about.

transfer.panel.export-images.note: Heading and button of the export step; counts the images that are exported.

vars.n: The count the text is about.

transfer.panel.export-shapes.note: Heading and button of the export step; counts the shapes that are exported.

vars.n: The count the text is about.

transfer.panel.export-themes.note: Heading and button of the export step; counts the themes that are exported.

transfer.panel.file-format.note: Label for the choice between export formats such as JSON and YAML.

transfer.panel.images-need-magic-card-ut.text: Images need Magic Card Utils. It is installed through HACS, like Magic Card.

transfer.panel.import-animations.note: Heading and button of the import step; counts the animations that are imported.

vars.n: The count the text is about.

transfer.panel.import-anyway.note: Button that proceeds with the import after the user has read the warnings.

transfer.panel.import-icons.note: Heading and button of the import step; counts the icons that are imported.

vars.n: The count the text is about.

transfer.panel.import-images.note: Heading and button of the import step; counts the images that are imported.

vars.n: The count the text is about.

transfer.panel.import-presets.note: Panel heading for importing theme presets. 'Presets' are saved dashboard themes.

transfer.panel.import-shapes.note: Heading and button of the import step; counts the shapes that are imported.

vars.n: The count the text is about.

transfer.panel.import-themes.note: Heading and button of the import step; counts the themes that are imported.

vars.n: The count the text is about.

transfer.panel.json-or-svg-up-to-8-mb.text: JSON or SVG, up to 8 MB
transfer.panel.json-or-svg-up-to-8-mb.note: Help text next to the file button for image imports. JSON, SVG and MB are fixed terms; the size limit is fixed.

transfer.panel.keep-both.note: Choice when imported names clash with saved ones: keep both copies. Pairs with 'Replace them'.

transfer.panel.magic-card-utils-is-not-i.text: Magic Card Utils is not installed, so these are saved as copies inside this card.
transfer.panel.magic-card-utils-is-not-i.note: Hint on the import panel when the add-on is missing. 'These' are the items about to be imported. Keep the product name unchanged.

transfer.panel.n.text: {n, plural, one {# value is kept as written. Check the list below.} other {# values are kept as written. Check the list below.}}

transfer.panel.n-2.note: Sentence ending (with a full stop) in the file summary. {n} counts informational notes about left-out or odd values. Differs from the version without a full stop, which is a list heading.

vars.n: The count the text is about.

transfer.panel.n-3.text: {n, plural, one {# value is kept as written} other {# values are kept as written}}
transfer.panel.n-3.note: Heading of a collapsible list, no full stop. {n} counts risky theme values that were kept unchanged. Shorter sibling of the summary sentence.

vars.n: The count the text is about.

transfer.panel.n-4.text: {n, plural, one {# value points to a file on the sharer's Home Assistant (url(/local/...)). It may not exist on your system.} other {# values point to files on the sharer's Home Assistant (url(/local/...)). They may not exist on your system.}}
transfer.panel.n-4.note: Warning, plural form. {n} counts theme values that point to files on the sharer's server. Keep url(/local/...) exactly as written; it is a code sample.

vars.n: The count the text is about.

transfer.panel.n-5.note: Heading of a collapsible list, no full stop. {n} counts informational notes. Sibling of the version that ends with a full stop.

vars.n: The count the text is about.

transfer.panel.n-6.text: {n, plural, one {{items} already exists} other {{items} already exist}}
transfer.panel.n-6.note: Label above the clash choice. {n} is how many clash, used only to pick the plural. {items} is a counted phrase such as '2 shapes', made elsewhere.

vars.items: The value that replaces items in the text.
vars.n: The count the text is about.

transfer.panel.nothing-to-export.note: Empty state when the chosen tab holds no items to export.

transfer.panel.or-paste-the-text.note: Label of the paste box, an alternative to 'Choose a file'. 'Or' links the two options.

transfer.panel.read.note: Button that reads (parses) the pasted text. Verb in the imperative, not the past tense and not the noun.

transfer.panel.replace-them.note: Choice when imported names clash: overwrite the saved items. 'Them' means the clashing items. Pairs with 'Keep both'.

transfer.panel.source-holds-animations.text: {n, plural, one {{source} holds # animation.} other {{source} holds # animations.}}
transfer.panel.source-holds-animations.note: Line under the import heading: what the chosen file or pasted text holds (animations).

vars.n: The count the text is about.
vars.source: The file name, or a word for the pasted text.

transfer.panel.source-holds-icons.text: {n, plural, one {{source} holds # icon.} other {{source} holds # icons.}}
transfer.panel.source-holds-icons.note: Line under the import heading: what the chosen file or pasted text holds (icons).

vars.n: The count the text is about.
vars.source: The file name, or a word for the pasted text.

transfer.panel.source-holds-images.text: {n, plural, one {{source} holds # image.} other {{source} holds # images.}}
transfer.panel.source-holds-images.note: Line under the import heading: what the chosen file or pasted text holds (images).

vars.n: The count the text is about.
vars.source: The file name, or a word for the pasted text.

transfer.panel.source-holds-shapes.text: {n, plural, one {{source} holds # shape.} other {{source} holds # shapes.}}
transfer.panel.source-holds-shapes.note: Line under the import heading: what the chosen file or pasted text holds (shapes).

vars.n: The count the text is about.
vars.source: The file name, or a word for the pasted text.

transfer.panel.source-holds-themes.text: {n, plural, one {{source} holds # theme.} other {{source} holds # themes.}}
transfer.panel.source-holds-themes.note: Line under the import heading: what the chosen file or pasted text holds (themes).

vars.n: The count the text is about.
vars.source: The file name, or a word for the pasted text.

transfer.panel.the-author-name-is-saved-.text: The author name is saved in the file. Check it before you share the file.
transfer.panel.the-author-name-is-saved-.note: Privacy hint on the export panel. The author name is the one stored in the card's settings.

transfer.panel.the-checker-for-images-di.text: The checker for images did not load, so this image was not read.
transfer.panel.the-checker-for-images-di.note: Error when the code that validates image files failed to load. 'Checker' is the validator, an internal part.

transfer.panel.the-checker-for-these-ani.text: The checker for these animations did not load, so the file was not read. Check your connection and try again.
transfer.panel.the-checker-for-these-ani.note: Error when the code that validates animation files failed to load, usually a network problem. 'Checker' is the validator.

transfer.panel.the-new-ones-get-a-number.text: The new ones get a number.
transfer.panel.the-new-ones-get-a-number.note: Explains the 'Keep both' choice: the imported copies get a number added to their names, for example 'Pulse 2'.

transfer.panel.the-saved-ones-are-overwr.note: Explains the 'Replace them' choice: items already saved are lost and the imported ones take their place.

transfer.panel.the-text.note: Stands in for a file name as {source} in 'holds' when the user pasted text. Must work at the start of a sentence.

transfer.panel.this-file-was-not-importe.note: Heading of an error notice, no full stop. A reason for the failure follows underneath.

transfer.panel.types-up-to-1-mb.note: Help text next to the file button. {types} is the accepted file types, such as 'JSON or YAML'. Shorter sibling of the SVG version.

vars.types: The value that replaces types in the text.

transfer.panel.types-up-to-1-mb-svg-up-t.text: {types}, up to 1 MB; SVG up to 32 KB
transfer.panel.types-up-to-1-mb-svg-up-t.note: Help text for icon imports. {types} is the accepted file types, such as 'JSON or YAML'. SVG files have a smaller limit.

vars.types: The value that replaces types in the text.

transfer.panel.update-magic-card-utils-t.text: Update Magic Card Utils to keep theme presets.
transfer.panel.update-magic-card-utils-t.note: Error notice in the import panel when the installed add-on is too old for theme presets. Same English as the library window hint.

transfer.panel.what-to-do-with-them.note: Accessible label of the clash choice group. 'Them' means the items whose names already exist.

transfer.panel.you-have-this-one.note: Marker beside an imported item that the user already has saved. Keep the brackets.

transfer.safe-parse.image-files-are-json.text: Image files are JSON, not YAML. Export them as JSON.
transfer.safe-parse.image-files-are-json.note: Import error when YAML is given where an image file is expected. It tells the user to export the images as JSON instead.

transfer.safe-parse.merge-keys-are-not-a.text: Merge keys (<<) are not allowed in preset files.
transfer.safe-parse.merge-keys-are-not-a.note: YAML parse error. A merge key is the YAML feature written as two less-than signs. Keep (<<) exactly as written.

transfer.safe-parse.not-valid-yaml-or-js.note: Import error when the pasted text cannot be parsed. It tells the user to check the text for typos or cut-off content.

transfer.safe-parse.numbers-must-be-fini.note: YAML parse error. .inf and .nan are YAML spellings for infinity and not-a-number; keep them exactly as written.

transfer.safe-parse.paste-or-choose-a-fi.text: Paste or choose a file first.
transfer.safe-parse.paste-or-choose-a-fi.note: Message when import is pressed with an empty box. It tells the user to paste text or choose a file before continuing.

transfer.safe-parse.this-file-is-larger-.text: This file is larger than 1 MB, so it was not read.
transfer.safe-parse.this-file-is-larger-.note: Size error from the text parser for animation, shape and theme files. 1 MB is a fixed limit.

transfer.safe-parse.this-file-is-larger-.text: This file is larger than 8 MB, so it was not read.
transfer.safe-parse.this-file-is-larger-.note: Size error from the text parser for image files. Same English as the envelope error. 8 MB is a fixed limit.

transfer.safe-parse.this-file-is-too-com.text: This file is too complex to read safely (too many nested or repeated values).
transfer.safe-parse.this-file-is-too-com.note: Import error when the file nests or repeats values beyond the safe-reading limits. It tells the user the file was refused, not partly read.

transfer.shape.a-shape-holds-at-most-max.text: {max, plural, one {A shape holds at most # point (this one has {n}).} other {A shape holds at most # points (this one has {n}).}}
transfer.shape.a-shape-holds-at-most-max.note: Import warning for a shape file with too many points. {max} is the largest number of points allowed, {n} is how many the file has. Both are numbers.

vars.max: The most points a shape can have.
vars.n: The number of points in the file.

transfer.shape.corner-name-is-not-valid-.text: Corner {name} is not valid, so it was left out.
transfer.shape.corner-name-is-not-valid-.note: Import note about one corner setting. {name} is the corner's identifier from the file, such as top-left; do not translate it.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

transfer.shape.key-is-not-a-corner-so-it.text: "{key}" is not a corner, so it was left out.
transfer.shape.key-is-not-a-corner-so-it.note: Import note about an unknown entry in the corners list. {key} is the entry's name from the file, shown in quotes; do not translate it.

vars.key: The value that replaces key in the text.

transfer.shape.key-is-not-a-shape-settin.text: "{key}" is not a shape setting, so it was left out.
transfer.shape.key-is-not-a-shape-settin.note: Import note about an unknown top-level entry in a shape file. {key} is the entry's name from the file, shown in quotes; do not translate it.

vars.key: The value that replaces key in the text.

transfer.shape.padding-name-is-not-valid.text: Padding "{name}" is not valid, so it was left out.
transfer.shape.padding-name-is-not-valid.note: Import note about one padding side. {name} is the side's identifier from the file, such as top; do not translate it.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

transfer.shape.point-n-is-not-valid-so-i.text: Point {n} is not valid, so it was left out.
transfer.shape.point-n-is-not-valid-so-i.note: Import note about one point in the shape's outline. {n} is the point's position in the list, counting from 1.

vars.n: The value that replaces n in the text.

transfer.shape.the-corner-size-is-not-va.text: The corner size is not valid, so it was left out.
transfer.shape.the-corner-size-is-not-va.note: Import report line for a shape whose corner size is out of range. The shape is still imported without that value.

transfer.shape.the-corner-type-is-not-va.text: The corner type is not valid, so it was left out.
transfer.shape.the-corner-type-is-not-va.note: Import report line for a shape with an unknown corner type. The shape is still imported without that value.

transfer.shape.the-corners-setting-is-no.text: The corners setting is not valid, so it was left out.
transfer.shape.the-corners-setting-is-no.note: Import report line for a shape whose overall corners setting is invalid. The shape is still imported without that value.

transfer.shape.the-padding-is-not-valid-.text: The padding is not valid, so it was left out.
transfer.shape.the-padding-is-not-valid-.note: Import report line for a shape whose text padding is invalid. The shape is still imported without that value.

transfer.shape.the-points-list-is-not-va.text: The points list is not valid, so it was left out.
transfer.shape.the-points-list-is-not-va.note: Import report line for a shape whose outline points are invalid. The shape is still imported without that value.

transfer.shape.the-shape-data-is-missing.note: Import error: the file has no shape section at all. Different from 'The shape has no valid settings'.

transfer.shape.the-shape-has-no-valid-se.text: The shape has no valid settings.
transfer.shape.the-shape-has-no-valid-se.note: Import error: a shape section exists but every setting in it was rejected. Different from 'The shape data is missing'.

transfer.shape.the-shape-is-larger-than-.text: The shape is larger than {kb} KB.
transfer.shape.the-shape-is-larger-than-.note: Import error. {kb} is the largest file size allowed, in kilobytes.

vars.kb: The value that replaces kb in the text.

transfer.shape.the-smoothing-is-not-vali.text: The smoothing is not valid, so it was left out.
transfer.shape.the-smoothing-is-not-vali.note: Import report line for a shape whose smoothing value is invalid. The shape is still imported without that value.

transfer.theme.another-website.note: Fallback wording used in place of a list of domain names when none could be worked out. Lower case, used mid-sentence.

transfer.theme.dark.note: Name of the dark colour mode of a theme, used as {mode} in import notes. Starts a sentence before 'mode:'.

transfer.theme.key-is-a-card-mod-style-i.text: "{key}" is a card-mod style. It was kept; with card-mod installed it runs CSS on your dashboard.
transfer.theme.key-is-a-card-mod-style-i.note: Import warning, whole-theme version. {key} is the variable's name from the file, in quotes; do not translate it. Keep card-mod unchanged. Sibling with a mode prefix below.

vars.key: The value that replaces key in the text.

transfer.theme.key-is-not-a-theme-variab.text: "{key}" is not a theme variable name, so it was left out.
transfer.theme.key-is-not-a-theme-variab.note: Import note. {key} is the entry's name from the file, in quotes; do not translate it. Theme variables are CSS custom properties that start with two hyphens or a known prefix.

vars.key: The value that replaces key in the text.

transfer.theme.key-points-to-hosts-it-wa.text: "{key}" points to {hosts}. It was kept; every browser that shows this theme will contact it.
transfer.theme.key-points-to-hosts-it-wa.note: Import warning, whole-theme version. {key} is the variable's name in quotes, {hosts} is a website domain list such as example.com. Do not translate either.

vars.hosts: The value that replaces hosts in the text.
vars.key: The value that replaces key in the text.

transfer.theme.key-uses-a-file-on-the-sh.text: "{key}" uses a file on the sharer's Home Assistant. It may not exist on your system.
transfer.theme.key-uses-a-file-on-the-sh.note: Import warning, whole-theme version. {key} is the variable's name in quotes; do not translate it. 'Sharer' is the person who made the file.

vars.key: The value that replaces key in the text.

transfer.theme.light.note: Name of the light colour mode of a theme, used as {mode} in import notes. Starts a sentence before 'mode:'.

transfer.theme.mode-mode-key-is-a-card-m.text: {mode} mode: "{key}" is a card-mod style. It was kept; with card-mod installed it runs CSS on your dashboard.
transfer.theme.mode-mode-key-is-a-card-m.note: Import warning for one colour mode. {mode} is the translated word Light or Dark, {key} is the variable's name from the file in quotes. Keep card-mod unchanged.

vars.key: The value that replaces key in the text.
vars.mode: The value that replaces mode in the text.

transfer.theme.mode-mode-key-points-to-h.text: {mode} mode: "{key}" points to {hosts}. It was kept; every browser that shows this theme will contact it.
transfer.theme.mode-mode-key-points-to-h.note: Import warning for one colour mode. {mode} is Light or Dark, {key} the variable's name in quotes, {hosts} a website domain list. Do not translate key or hosts.

vars.hosts: The value that replaces hosts in the text.
vars.key: The value that replaces key in the text.
vars.mode: The value that replaces mode in the text.

transfer.theme.mode-mode-key-uses-a-file.text: {mode} mode: "{key}" uses a file on the sharer's Home Assistant. It may not exist on your system.
transfer.theme.mode-mode-key-uses-a-file.note: Import warning for one colour mode. {mode} is Light or Dark, {key} the variable's name in quotes; do not translate key.

vars.key: The value that replaces key in the text.
vars.mode: The value that replaces mode in the text.

transfer.theme.modes-key-is-not-light-or.text: "modes.{key}" is not light or dark, so it was left out.
transfer.theme.modes-key-is-not-light-or.note: Import note. Keep 'modes.' and the word before the placeholder as written: {key} is an unexpected entry name under modes in the file. Light and dark are the setting values.

vars.key: The value that replaces key in the text.

transfer.theme.modes-must-hold-light-and.text: "modes" must hold light and dark, so it was left out.
transfer.theme.modes-must-hold-light-and.note: Import note. 'modes' is the setting name in the file and stays unchanged; light and dark are its two required entries.

transfer.theme.the-theme-data-is-missing.note: Import error: the file has no theme section at all. Different from 'The theme has no variables'.

transfer.theme.the-theme-has-no-variable.note: Import error: a theme section exists but holds no usable theme variables. Different from 'The theme data is missing'.

transfer.theme.the-theme-is-larger-than-.text: The theme is larger than {kb} KB.
transfer.theme.the-theme-is-larger-than-.note: Import error. {kb} is the largest file size allowed, in kilobytes.

vars.kb: The value that replaces kb in the text.

transfer.theme.the-value-of-key-is-longe.text: {max, plural, one {The value of "{key}" is longer than # character, so it was left out.} other {The value of "{key}" is longer than # characters, so it was left out.}}
transfer.theme.the-value-of-key-is-longe.note: Import note. {key} is the variable's name from the file, in quotes; do not translate it. {max} is the largest number of characters allowed, a number.

vars.key: The value that replaces key in the text.
vars.max: The most characters a value can have.

transfer.theme.the-value-of-key-is-not-t.text: The value of "{key}" is not text or a number, so it was left out.
transfer.theme.the-value-of-key-is-not-t.note: Import note. {key} is the variable's name from the file, in quotes; do not translate it. The value was a list or object, which themes cannot use.

vars.key: The value that replaces key in the text.
